verses.en: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.sm: Aua e lelei ona fai pesega i lo tatou Atua; ana e matagofie, e ono lava le viiga.

verses.en: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.sm: O loc atiina ae Ierusalema e le Aw; e faapotopotoina e ia o Isaraelu sa tulia.

verses.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.sm: E faamaloloina e ia e ua loto momomo; e fufusi e ia o latou manua.

verses.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.sm: O loo faitaulia e ia le aofai o fetu; ua faaigoaina e ia o latou igoa uma lava.

verses.en: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.sm: Esilsili lava lo tatou AW, e tele lona malosi; e le ma faamatalaina lona poto.

verses.en: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.sm: E lagolago le ALII i c ua puapuagatia; a e lafotuina e ia e ua amio leaga ia toele.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.sm: Ia outou pepese atu i le ALII i le viiga; ia outou fai pesega i lo tatou Atua i le kitara.

verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.sm: O le ufitia le lagi i ao, o le saunia le ua mo le eleele; o lè faatupu le mutia i mauga.

verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.sm: Olé avatu i le manu vaefa lana mea e ‘ai, e faapea foi i le toloai a le oreva,

verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.sm: pe a tagi ia te ia. Io Ele 6a6a o ia i le malosi o le solofanua; e le finagalo ia i vac o le tagata.

verses.en: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.sm: O loo finagalo le ALII i e matatau ia te ia, o e faamoemoe i lona alofa.

verses.en: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.sm: Ierusalema e, ia e vivii atu i le ALII; Sona e, ia e vivii atu i lou Atua;

verses.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.sm: auā o loo faamalosia e ia o faamau faalava o ou puipui; o loo faamanuia e ia lau fanau i totonu ia te oe.

verses.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.sm: 15 16 17 18 19 O lē faatupu le filemu i ou tuaoi; o le fafaga ia te oe ia mafona ile saito e sili ona lelei.

verses.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.sm: O loo auina mai e ia lana poloaiga i le nuu, e momo'e tele vave lana afioga.

verses.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.sm: O le auina mai le kiona e pei o fulufulu mamoe; o le na te lulusoloina le sauto

verses.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.sm: ‘a e pei o lefulefu. O lē awna mai lana vaito'a pei o momoi mea.

verses.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.sm: O ai se na te tulai i luma o lona maalili? E túlei mai lana afioga, ona liu suāvai ai lea o ia mea; e faaagi mai e ia lona matagi, ona tafe mai ai lea o vai.

verses.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.sm: Na te faaalia ana afioga ia Iakopo; o ana tulafono ma faamasinoga ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.sm: E lei faapea ona faia e ia i se tasi lava nuu; e lei iloa foi e i latou ana faamasinoga. Ia outou vivii atu i le ALII.
